summary: git returns the commit before and after the update, old and new .git dir paths if changed, and whether the remote URL changed.
questions: How do I know if git pulled new commits?
Which commit is now checked out after the git task?
Did the git remote URL change?

answer_card.title: git return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `before`: previous commit ("null" for new clone)
- `after`: commit after update
- `remote_url_changed` (bool)
- `git_dir_before` / `git_dir_now`
